rationale: P characterises the vehicle braking behaviour that must be evaluated to determine whether unintended braking is prevented, as required by SG-3. Its operational scope is explicitly supported by H-3. Braking behaviour is itself the subject of the evaluation, rather than merely a control mechanism affecting another phenomenon. P does not extend to sensing, computation, failure mitigation, warnings, or mechanism timing constraints.
determining_elements: The vehicle's braking behaviour is directly relevant to evaluating prevention of unintended braking.
The scope includes whether braking occurs and whether it is intended or unintended.
The straight-ahead urban driving situation at 50 km/h, in good weather and without visible obstacles or vehicles ahead, matches H-3's operational situation.
No observation, communication, internal control, or timing mechanisms are incorporated into P.
